description: Act on a decision Snippet is holding for the creator: approve, decline, counter with edited text, or answer a question. This commits the creator, for example sending a pitch or reply, or accepting or declining terms, and often cannot be undone. Read the decision and its terms back to the creator and get an explicit yes in this conversation first. Pass the item's id and its version, found at needs_you.items[].agent_approval.version (or agent_question.version) in get_manager_briefing; if they are stale nothing happens.

action.description: approve, decline, edit_and_approve (send the edited draft), answer (reply to a question) or cancel (stop something Snippet is about to do).
action.title: Action

answer.description: The creator's answer, or an option id, when action is answer.
answer.title: Answer

decision_id.description: The id of the item in get_manager_briefing's needs_you.
decision_id.title: Decision Id

version.description: The item's agent_approval.version or agent_question.version from get_manager_briefing.
version.title: Version

name: answer_decision
title: Answer decision
